digest.component_or_area: rebar plan-review gate documentation and guides
propositions: Author-facing guides currently describe a Success Criteria / Acceptance Criteria split that no longer applies after the collapsed vocabulary changes, instructing authors to write headings nothing reads.

The leaf-vs-container section rule must be rewritten to describe containers by what actually differs: they need Acceptance Criteria plus child decomposition covering it and testing deferred to children, not by Success Criteria vocabulary.

All Success Criteria vocabulary must be removed from the packaged guides and user documentation except for four permanent carve-outs (plan_review_T2.md experiment context, dod_uncertifiable concept, and plan-review-criteria-guide.md generated content).

The rewritten container guidance must remain specific and actionable—stating the decomposition/coverage requirement—rather than collapsing to a vacuous statement that containers need Acceptance Criteria.
